anchors.value: documenting and contributing to the system is the work tokens come from; contribution is documented, verified, receipted, then rewarded in HHC/PoWP
the old miners proved the model: contribute infrastructure/work, get tokens; the underlying blockchain/mining infrastructure and pattern are already there, we do not need to invent that layer
HHC is a utility credit for verified contribution inside the mesh today, no cash-out by design; never promise value or returns publicly

links: Proof of Pay escrow 90/10, verifiers paid from fee pool
forecast: Widening what counts as mining - compute, verification, documentation, teaching - widens who can earn a first token, including intimidated new users making a first documented contribution
